prompt: How to merge two different communication flows involving partner A, B and a middle man C where A and B only is able to communicate with C?
response: To merge the communication flows, you can establish a protocol where A and B each send their messages to C, who then relays them to the other party. C should keep a log of all messages to ensure synchronization. This method ensures that A and B can indirectly communicate through C without needing direct contact.
